balls.text: Beaten, bye run through anyway. Was a yorker just outside off, went under the attempted straight drive. Samson lobbed it well over the batter as he ran late. No direct hit at the other end
Missed yorker. Shin-high full toss is square driven off a thick edge to deep third
Lol Hardik struggles for so long and Boult boshes his first ball for six. Slot ball from over the wicket this time, he gets low and smears it over cow corner. High-intensity glove punch follows

Hardik's misery ends. Looked like he timed it well for a change but it's taken well inside the deep-midwicket boundary. 137ks slot ball angling in at the stumps. Hardik was standing at an angle and was behind it too, went for the lofted on-drive and held the pose instead of following through fully.
Yorker outside off, Hardik does move across but can't elevate it. Chomps a drive through cover
Same leg-stump yorker attempted. Goes down leg
Noor fumbles. Ran quite a distance to the left from deep square leg, looked to pick it up and throw to Brevis who was coming from the other end. Failed. Was a full ball on the pads that was flicked

Spins away to the left but the fielder keeps it in. Kamboj gets on one knee and stops the dribbling ball. Back of length on the hips at over 140ks. Hardik flicked it off the back foot, aerial but seemed off the leading edge
Full outside off, slower one is driven along the ground through cover
Short outside off, beats the hard cut and Hardik's woes continue

Hardik not allowed to swing his bat fully. 147ks back of length ball shots off the pitch and cramps him for room as he shapes for the pull. Bat not even at the perpendicular as ball comes in and hits it. Hardik dangling on one knee as he bunts it into the pitch last second
145ks hard length just outside off. Bhagat gets behind it and punches to deep point
Samson pumps his fists after taking catching it. No edge but you see he values dots. Short ball followed Bhagat as he made room and beat the pull
Full on off, driven to long-on
Low full toss is flicked to deep midwicket. Hardik was deep in the crease and lost his balance as the back leg was in the air
'Can't be in the slot,' Katey Martin says on air. Ball is in slot and Kamboj gets away. Driven to long-on
Shortish on leg, 130ks, flicked with limited timing to midwicket
Ball is onion, bat is knife. Minz angled the bat, not fully horizontal, as Minz looked to cut it through cover. Bounced onto the stumps. 132ks back of length ball was outside off and the shot was on
Slot ball smacked flat over cover. Wide and full, Minz gets on knee to get low and slap it with a horizontal bat. Gets a thumbs up from Hardik
Pitched up outside off, thick edge off the cover drive goes to deep third

Sarfaraz brings out the slider at cover. Ran left, took it with a jump and fell across while ensuring the wrist was above the ground. Dhir yelled as the catch was completed. Slower 123ks ball was full at the stumps, Dhir made room and looked to go inside out
First six since... forever. Since 9.3 over actually. 146ks slot ball angles in at leg. Dhir squats, gets his front shoulder across before picking it up with a lofted flick over backward square
Slot ball is unpunished. Slow at 120ks. Hardik going too square with the slog. Along the ground to deep midwicket, it gently rolls
Looks to pull it off a hard length, goes off the edge towards square leg

Tight bouncer, goes over the pull. 140ks. Ayeee... Samson misses it high to his left. Stopped at deep fine leg. That was right over middle and leg, Went just beside Naman around neck-height. Wow, wide redacted later, runs given. That will go down as a chance. Gets Dhir to fifty too
Noor's drag-downs are un-hittable it seems. This is flat but didn't look pacy. Just outside off, back-foot driven to cover. Timeout, surprised MI didn't take it earlier
Another pull, this to deep midwicket. This was a proper drag-down too, just outside off
Noor goes all Krunal and bumps it like a medium pacer. Very, very short. Sits up outside off too. Hardik mistimes a pull to long-on

Beaten. 94ks length ball landed on off and kept going away with the angle. Pandya stook in front of leg and looked to slap it through extra off the back foot. Umpire review sent for stumping. Ball goes millimetres over the top edge. Hardik on his toes in the crease, slides forward and back, doesn't look like it was ever lifted. Samson quick again
Back of length on off, 93ks. Flat and no spin. Bunt-pulled to deep midwicket
Length down leg, flicked to square leg. Actually beat the flick and went off the thigh
Pitched up, fuller side of length, just outside off. Punched to long-off. 132ks
Pitched up at the stumps, gets a thick inside edge to midwicket. Dhir looking to punch it straighter
Great variation again. 122ks offcutter is fullish and outside off, grubber too. Dhir looks to drive through cover, half-collapses but still ball goes under bat.
Back of length in the channel at 136ks, punchy square drive to deep point
Length in the channel, bunted to cover

Lucky Hardik. Didn't carry last over, goes wide of Samson this time. Slower ball wide outside off and full, Hardik clears the front leg and uses his hands to reach out and slap it. Thick edge bubbles away around hip-height to where first slip would've been
Length around off, defended towards cover
This is like a Test set-up. Has Hardik hang his bat outside off and search for it with an ungainly push in follow-through. The length ball outside off nearly takes the edge
Edge... falls short of the keeper. Samson takes it on the half-volley. Length on off, Hardik is on off stump and angles the vertical bat, brings it close to his body. Still catches the edge

Thrown back by the bowler, may have hit Hardik as he runs back. No, but Hardik - who came out and slid back - lost his balance and his knee stuck in the ground. Was a full ball that was smother-driven to the bowler's right
Shovelled off a length to deep square leg

That's different. Hardik dances down only to leave the ball, Samson fumbles behind to concede a bye. Overton went short and just outside off, ball zipped off the pitch and bounced big. Went high to the keeper
Pitched up outside off, driven to deep cover

Miscommunication at cover but catch is taken! Gaikwad called for it going to the right at cover, Urvil didn't hear and kept going in his direction. Nearly shoulder-barged the skipper but Gaikwad turned to the right and took it nicely. Was a legbreak on a length just outside off, Tilak was beside the ball and went for the slog sweep. Got a top edge
Bites the outside edge, spins on the bounce to Dube's left at short third. Did well to stop it with just his left hand.
Length on leg, flicked towards midwicket. May have gone off the glove. Bowler stops it. 91ks
Full on leg, flicked to deep midwicket

Samson celebrappeals a stumping, referred. 96ks length ball just outside off. Ripping away and beating the inside-out cover drive. Close to the bat, so Ultra-Edge will be brought in too. No edge. Juicy bit coming... with a nice little delay. Tri-screen. Batter just got out of the crease but slid it back, Samson was quick but not as much as Dhir. Small margins, batter too good this time

Goes for the falling paddle and misses. The back leg was next to the offside tramline early, he was lunging across with limited balance too. Overton may have spotted him and went back of length and slow. Beats bat and hits him on the back of the hand, goes leg side
Length on leg, flicked to deep square leg's right. He runs in diagonally, can't stop two
Beaten on the cut. Back of length just outside off at 146ks, angles away and zips through
Half-stop at mid-off by Gaikwad, dove to the right and sprinted back to the boundary. Slid... just within the ropes while pulling the ball in. Pitched up on off, driven nicely
Length on leg, flicked to midwicket

Almost taken. Dube was at the edge of the ring at cover, a little slow to pick it up. Had to run in and dive, got half-volleyed. Was a slower ball on a back of length outside off that reared up. Got big on Tilak as he went for the cut
Driven to cover on the rise and with a flourish. Slower fullish ball outside off
Length just outside off, punched off the back foot to cover

Jaffa in T20verse. More importantly, it's Ghosh's first IPL wicket. 133ks halfway down and outside off, may not have been as wide as SKY wanted as he went for the lofted cut. Yanked the back leg up while hitting from around rib-height, found deep point to perfection. Brevis, the fielder, was standing well in too
Slower length ball outside off, square driven super late. Veer at backward point, moves left quickly and dives to stop it. Dhir slaps his bat while running
Slappage again, this time over mid-off. Hard length around fourth, Dhir staying leg side of the ball
Disrespects hard length by dancing down and slapping it over extra cover. Lucky he got a bit of room, did well to hit it on the rise
On a length and attacking the off stump. Dhir jumps deeper into his crease and cuts this from quite close to his body. Gets it down to deep cover.
On a length and Dhir looks for a drive towards long-on. Can't get it past the bowler's boots, off which the ball ricochets
Pulls the length back. Still attacking the stumps. Flicked down to cow corner
Huge bunt and it's rocketing over long-off! The ball was too full and sliding down the off side. He just gets down on one knee and saddles this lofted drive over the ropes
Back of a length and spinning away from SKY, but it's a drag-down and SKY won't miss out. Goes on the backfoot and he tickles this cut past diving covers
On a length outside off. Defended down to point and Dhir happy to get to the other end
Full-ish on the stumps. Casual flick towards cow corner
On a length and seaming back in. SKY plays a late glide towards deep backward point
Keeps low, keeps low... Outside off and moving back in. SKY jumped at this and then had to almost bury his bat in the pitch to keep the ball out
Another classic SKY shot! Too much width off a length, outside off, and SKY frees his arms to almosty helicopter a pull past deep point
On a length at the stumps. An awkward flick that only goes down to mid-wicket
Back of a length and rising back into the batter. Bunted down to extra cover and they take off for a run. Ramakrishna has fallen down in his run-up too, but looks okay!
On a length towards the leg side. He runs down the track and flicks it down towards cow corner
Full and on the stumps, now driven down to covers
Floated up on a length, now driven towards mid-off. Doesn't middle this and certainly can't get it past the fielder lying in wait there

Smart batting this. Full and flighted up, SKY can't get under this so he is content with a flick into the vacant region to the right of the bowler. Dribbles towards Noor, running in, and SKY has rushed to the other end in the meantime
Dhir is playing on a different track here. Runs down the pitch to convert this into a full ball, an inside-out drive - hit with the turn too - flies over the deep extra cover boundary
Flighted full and following the batter as he strays into the leg side. Driven back to him
Back of a length and great bounce on this. All thanks to his pace: 94.6 kph on this occasion. Spins away from the batter, and SKY defends it back to the bowler
On a length and spinning away from the right-hander. SKY shows that trademark glide of his, bunting it down to deep backward point

And this time Rickelton departs. The ball was on a length, rushed onto the batter as he got down on one knee to try and loft a sweep. Couldn't get under this at all, and mistimes the ball over to deep midwicket
Fancy reverse sweep, Rickelton almost falls over. Down to covers

Dube has put down a generational dolly! He flicks the ball back in anger, but that will do him no well. The ball was a ripper, absolutely reared up at the batter from outside off and caught the batter's outside edge on the flick he is cramped into. Dube is lying in wait at backward point but the ball just skeedaddles out of his hands
Back of a length and kept outside off, right on the wide marker. Rolls his wrists on this pull and gets it down to point
Attacking the stumps. Flicked down to cow corner, Rickelton has been getting under these balls quite well
Lowww full outside off, driven down to mid-off but can't get it past the fielder.
Speared in full, flicked down to deep square leg. Deep midwicket runs in to collect this
Hits him on the pads, modest appeal, but pitching down leg. The ball dribbles down to point and they sneak in a legbye
Times the screws out of this lofted flick! On a length and drifting into his pads. Keeps still and rolls his wrists at this ball as it flies over cow corner
Kept full, attacking the stumps. Driven down to long-off

Good thinking from the bowler, but result the same. He slowed it down further, tried to drag the length back just a little. But the flat release doesn't matter: Rickelton's still found this in his hitting arc, so he hits it over long-on once more

He boshes this over long-on! Floats this up in the slot, the pace a little too low and spin too less for this to be a good delivery. Rickelton swings through the line and the ball sails over the fielder
Full-ish outside off, driven straight to extra cover now

Goes on a length, right on the stumps, and he's punished. Not much spin on offer off that length, and Rickelton gets down on one knee and inside the line of the delivery. Swipes it over deep midwicket
Another full ball with plenty of flight. On fifth stump and driven down to long-off
Floats this in quiteee full, right outside off. Rickelton does well to defend this back to the bowler
On a length outside off, driven past covers and another easy single on offer

Rickelton gives up a day and a half ago, but somehow survives. Speared in the blockhole and bunted past the bowler. Except Kamboj leaps in the air, to his right, and just flings this back at the stumps. Misses. Did he go too early?
Huge swipe but swishing at air! The ball was full and swung away even as Rickelton looked to get into the action. Misread the line once again
Now the length is just a little fuller, outside off. He punches a drive, late, past point and gets to the other end

Dhir has such a solid base! The ball sat up, back of a length and rising at him. There to be hit and he obliges with a still head and a big swipe across the line. Pandya-esque lack of motion besides just his wrists, and he sends it over cow corner
On a length swinging away. Confident, grounded drive to covers again

Dhir gets into the action now. Sat back of a length and rose right at him, he swipes a pull down to deep midwicket. Can't quite pierce the gap past the fielder, who runs in with plenty of time, because he didn't quite middle this one
On a length outside off. Punched down to covers and he takes off for an easy single this time
Yes, no, yes, no - Rickelton almost sells his wicket down the river. Length ball outside off punched towards covers and then he takes off, but rightly sent back. No run there

And now he's leathered this one over cow corner! The length was pulled back, but Rickelton's playing mind games here. He knows the ball that's about to come, so he sits back in the crease and just swings through the line

Rickelton steps down the pitch and asserts his class! The ball was swinging, on a length and on fifth stump. Rickelton's movement converted this into a full ball, and he lofts an impeccable drive over deep extra cover
Back of a length outside off. Another huge swish across the line, and Rickelton misses the line too
Dhir goes for another hoick down the ground, but doesn't make contact! The ball was back of a length outside off. Dhir has a go at it but swishes at air again. Can't read the movement in this over

Jags back in and cuts him up in half! Even wider and on a length again. Dhir goes for an expansive drive away from his body, but the ball swings back in, like Kamboj planned for this too. Just misses out on the edge
full and probing him right in the blockhole! The ball was seaming in right at the stumps. Dhir goes for a flick but the bottom edge flies off the bat and down to deep fine leg
Subtle lateral movement on this again. Outside off, seams away from the batter even as he threads a drive right to covers

Absolute stunner from Ramakrishna! This was on a length and outside off. Jacks, looking to force the issue, runs down and hoicks a lofted drive in the air. Grabs the bottom edge of the bat and it flies towards deep point. Ramakrishna runs in and pockets this with a big dive
runs down the track but to no avail! Outside off on a length. Jacks steps down but can only bosh this drive down to extra cover
Another probing ball... Right outside off and on a length. Can only bash this down to covers
On a length and swinging into the batter. Rides the bounce on his drive down to mid-on
Full-ish and great shape on this. Defended down to covers. Watchful start from MI
Back of a length and rising at him. He glides this close under his eyes, quite late, down to deep backward point
Full and flush on the pads. Goes for a big flick but misses the line of the ball completely, thuds into his pads but way down leg
Back of a length and great bounce! Moves away from Jacks, who goes for a slash away from his body but not with much conviction

Late reverse to finish, amazing reverse to finish. Kartik was deep in the crease, likely awaiting the yorker. Got a fullish length ball that angled away sharply. So he stood diagonally in front of the wideline and saucered the bat across his body to lift it over short third. Gun celebrations from Kartik
Dances down and looks to drive through cover, nearly yorks himself and inside edges it onto body
Pulls it to deep square leg and raises his bat high does Kartik, upon getting to fifty
Near yorker on off is driven well. Hard hit to the left of long-on
A little late but the slower ones are working. Hard length outside off, beats the pull
Slower grubber beats the slog. Fullish length just outside off, the back-of-hand ball lands once, twice befote reaching the keeper
Pitched up on off, punches it aerially and finds long-on. Chants of CSK, CSK follow
Full on leg, flicked to midwicket
'Boundary' is Vairavan's call right after the shot, ball rifles wide of long-off. Overpitched, slow and outside off. Kartik staying still and thrashing a full-blooded drive
Winds up big again, but the ball skids through to beat him. It was on a length outside off, Kartik looked to poke it late
Six, our scorers go, right after ball touched bat. Six it is. Danced down, got to the pitch and flicked it off the pads. Massive back-lift and follow through to send it sailing over midwicket
Length on leg, flicked towards midwicket
Cut hard, beats long-off. Short and wide, Kartik wound up big and got it through extra cover, Tilak ran across and dove in despair
Slow bouncer. 105ks. Landed around off and angled away. Beats the twirl pull
Boult keeps going for the yorker, delivers a wide 131ks full toss around knee-roll height. Slapped to deep cover
Looks for a repeat. Gets less room and to it on the low full toss. Drives to cover. 132ks ball was on leg stump
Off-driven after dancing down to a 131ks ball. Got to the pitch of the cross-seamer and times the pants off it
Wide or not? It is. Short ball landed around leg and tennis-ball bounced over fifth stump. Gaikwad went back, may have thought of the upper cut, let it go
130ks but looked pacier. This yorker is on leg and is jammed to the bowler
Dipping low full toss outside off, Gaikwad collapses a bit as he was too early into the cover drive. Gets it to the infielder. 126ks
Another direct hit, looked much tighter... Background replay in and... no, not tight. Was a low full toss that was punched to mid-off. Timeout
Brave, dancing down to Bumrah. Gets close to the pitch and punches to cover. Direct hit at the non-striker's. MI confident but replay shows Kartik was well in
137iks ball dug very short, angles over leg. Ducked under. Looked wide, not given. CSK review. Gaikwad was nearly on one knee. It's given wide on height
Shortish slow ball just outside off, 121ks, bunted with a vertical bat to Jacks' right at cover. Diving stop denes the run
Bouncer over off, ducked under. This bounced more
Picks up the short ball quickly. Pulled from off stump, hip-high ball. Not much bounce
Back of length on leg, 138ks, flicked to midwicket, who's standing close
Overpitched and looped outside off, Gaikwad gets on one knee and slaps it through cover
Dances down and the length ball is on leg stump, defended towards cover
Rickelton's happy with that. The fullish length ball on leg is square cut towards point
Fullish loopy ball on middle, flicked to midwicket
Full and flat on middle, driven to deep cover
Pitched up just outside off, defended towards cover-point. Gaikwad gets to fifty
Front-of-the-hand length ball outside off at 92ks, caressed to deep point
Length in the channel, clears the front leg and cuts to long-off
Full on leg, flicked to square leg. 50-run stand up in 43 balls
Dances down and gets hurried by the 90ks length ball. Not to the pitch as he check-punches to long-on. Went off the inside-half
May have turned away a bit. Legbreak on a length on middle and off, defended towards cover. 89ks
Tight second. Throw is hard and at the bowler, not collected cleanly as Kartik scampered. Length on middle, flicked along the ground
Short outside off, beats the attempted upper cut
Hard length at 124ks, worked off the back foot to long-on
Short and wide, slower ball sat up for an age
Fullish length in the channel, defended towards cover point
Touch back of length outside off, cut off a thick edge to deep third
Slot ball has been clobbered... just over long-on. Kartik went after the length
Full on leg, flicked to deep midwicket
Looks to slug it over long-on off a length. Made room too. Cloths it along the ground
Length on leg, flicked to deep midwicket
Flatter length ball around outside, punched to cover
Length outside off, punched to cover
Length outside off, cut to cover
Back of a length and rising at his chest. Flicked away to deep midwicket
Sticks to the same length outside off. Easy drive down to long-on
Back of a length and sits up at the hips of the batter. Flicked down to deep midwicket
Back of a length outside off, now played down to deep cover with a late drive
Short, but too short. Sails way over the head of the batter and the umpire spreads his arms - time to reload
Back of a length and outside off once more. Plays this aerially down to deep covers
Back of a length outside off. 120.2 clicks, but not an intentional slower one, just stuck in the pitch. Played out to covers
On a length outside off. Another easy drive on offer. Batter opts for it and gets it to deep extra cover
Back of a length and spinning into his pads. Goes on the backfoot and knocks this down to long-on
On a length and the stumps-line is treating him well, the low bounce even more useful. Defended down to mid-off
Back of a length again, keeping at the stumps. Pulled towards deep square leg
On a length and now lofted over the in-field, deep midwicket runs in to cut off the boundary
On a length and he's getting good grip and low bounce off this pitch

Just over Jacks at deep midwicket! Huge bat speed on this one. Back of a length at the stumps, sitting up to be hit. He goes on the backfoot and absolutely boshes this one over the ropes. Jacks is a few yards into the field, off the ropes. Should have been at the ropes and an easy catch...
On a length outside off. Kartik steps down the pitch and defends it to the left of the bowler
On a length and drifting into the pads. Flicked down to deep midwicket
Full-ish at the stumps. Flicked towards backward square. Was slow off the bat and Rickelton ran all the way to the edge of the thirty-yard circle to field this one
On a length at the pads. Flicked towards mid-wicket, Rickelton has thoughts behind the stumps once more
Back of a length and coming back into the right-hander. An aerial flick bunted down to cow corner
Keeps lowww once more. On a length and flicked to the right of the bowler, who puts in a big run to dive and stop this
Well outside off, cut towards deep cover and they'll pick up any easy single
Defended towards point. Full-ish and right on the off-stump
That's one way to get off the mark! On a length, he runs down the pitch and just lofts it down to long-on. Googly but stepping down meant he didn't need to bother too much about the turn
On a length outside off. Goes on the backfoot and down to covers
On a length outside off, driven down to covers
Back of a length and keeps low-ish once more. Cut to point on the back foot but can't get it past the fielder
Back of a length and outside off. Spins back in and bunted down to mid-on
Urvil's show comes to an end. He was down on one knee, looking for another big swing to this length ball outside off. But it catches his bottom edge and rifles straight into the stumps
On a length at the stumps. A nonchalant flick down to mid-on
Gaikwad reminds us he's got the big hits too! CSK bossing the powerplay so far. On a length and rising at him. He gets on one knee and sweeps him over the deep square ropes
On a length and driven down to the covers
Helicopters a stunning flick over deep midwicket! On a length, following the batter down into the leg side. His wrists do immense work here as he just middles this one over the ropes
Back of a length outside off, bunted down to mid-wicket
Back of a length outside off. He glides this down deep backward point
Full-ish and slows it down. On the stumps and he flicks this down to long-on, reaching for it as it comes to him later than he expected
Urvil chances his arm once more, and somehow gets it down to long-on! Back of a length and not even a bad ball, but somehow he hoicks a lofted drive down the ground

He's bazookad this over deep fine leg! Back of a length rising at his hips. He just lofts this fine, across the line, and somehow gets it behind him by swiveling his hips. Got under the ball perfectly
On a length at the pads, flicked down to long leg
Huge swing and miss... Outside off and on a length, swings back into the batter and whistles past the off-stump.
Bumrah is making the ball talk here. Urvil receives a back of a length delivery, keeps lower than he expected. Thuds right into his hips, got to hurt
Edge but past the keeper! Just needed to get it past the diving Rickelton. Bouncer and drifting into his helmet, 138 clicks. Off the glove and runs down to deep fine leg
On a length and swinging into the keeper. Exaggerated bounce on this once more. Defended down to mid-on
Full-ish and drfits onto the pads. Easy flick down to long leg and he'll feel happy about getting off strike
And now he's flicked this over the ropes! Is Gaikwad coming to the party here? The ball was on a length but drifting too far down leg, hit from in front of his pads
Great timing on this one, read the length like a fortune teller! Was too short and rose right in front of his eyes. Swivel-pulls this in front of deep square
Back of a length and rising at the batter. Gaikwad goes for a flick and can't middle this, since it rose at him too much
Banged in too short, time to reload
On a length and ball is moving away from outside off. Driven down to the covers, more like mistimed into the turf
Back of a length, and another wristy flick from Gaikwad. Gets it down to deep square leg and burgles two more easy runs
Full, too full, right outside off. Gaikwad threads a drive down to long-off with panache

And this time Bumrah gets the wicket! Back of a length and rising, rising, edged. Samson goes for another waft without much foot movement and can only bunt it back to the keeper. Rickelton puts in an amazing dive to his right to pouch this in his gloves

How's Sanju put it through the gaps? He is almost a dancing flamingo, on one leg as the front one lifts up from the ground. On a length outside off, he punches this through covers and beats three fielders before bashing into the ropes
Banger of an over, this. Another swing and miss: on a length outside off, tempting Samson into a swing down the ground but he misses the line of the delivery once more
Another outside edge! Ball is on a length outside off, Gaikwad goes for a huge booming drive. Flies down to deep backward point
Samson struggles to get on top of the bounce here. Back of a length and rears up at another defensive prod

How costly will that blunder be? Will Jacks has put down an absolute sitter at first slip. Bumrah did what Bumrah does: he got the ball to land outside off on a perfect length, jagging back and getting the edge off Samson's prodding defense. Outside edge put down
Punches a drive to mid-off and runs to the other end now! Smart use of the conditions and not very swinging lines from Boult, who went on a length instead of full-ish like he usually does
Crunches a drive through to deep cover! All hands, this, for Sanju Samson. Ball sat up on a length at the stumps, nothing too wrong with it. But Samson gets it away anyway
On a length and at the pads. Samson tucks a drive down to mid-on
On a length, flicked down to long leg. Not the most threatening start from Boult so far
Fuller and attacking the stumps. Crouches in his defense and sends it back to Boult
On a length and rising at Samson's hips. Tucked away to deep square
